name: snauhaus/link_compustat_ibes
what_it_holds: Python script (18 stars, MIT) that builds a linking table between I/B/E/S (analyst estimates) and Compustat identifiers -- standard WRDS-side plumbing academics use before merging consensus-estimate history onto fundamentals.
why_useful: Relevant only if the team ever gets WRDS/I-B-E-S access (UF likely has an institutional WRDS subscription) -- would let us build a genuinely point-in-time analyst-consensus-revision history for ABNB/BKNG/EXPE (gap #4) rather than pull-date-anchored Bloomberg snapshots. No data included in the repo itself, and WRDS access is a paid/licensed academic resource, not free/open.

license: MIT (code only; IBES/Compustat data itself is licensed via WRDS, not open)
